'''Radiomás''' is the state radio network of the Mexican state of [[Veracruz]]. It broadcasts on five FM transmitters in the state{{mexico-inf|FM|accessdate=2015-06-20}} with most content originating from the state capital in [[Xalapa]].

==History==
Radiomás came to air on April 6, 2000, with music and pre-recorded IDs. Program production began by that July.<ref>{{cite news|work=Formato 7|date=18 January 2017|accessdate=25 January 2017|title=La nueva era de Radio Más, el retorno a la identidad y la cultura|url=https://formato7.com/2017/01/18/la-nueva-radio-mas-retorno-la-identidad-la-cultura/|first=Luis|last=Barria}}</ref>

The two lowest-powered transmitters in the network, XHIXH-FM 107.3 Ixhuatlán de Madero (400 watts) and XHSTX-FM 89.7 Santiago Tuxtla (167 watts), were shut down and their permits surrendered on December 21, 2016.<ref>[http://www.ift.org.mx/sites/default/files/conocenos/pleno/sesiones/ordinaria/xxiv-ordinaria-del-pleno-10-de-agosto-de-2016/acta24aord100816canexo.pdf IFT Acta - XXIV Sesión Ordinaria del Pleno (revised)]</ref>
